planets.name: K2-232 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-232 with a 11.2-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-232 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-232. Its orbit and size follow Ranshaw et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
